out.summary: Asian Paints is India's leading decorative paints company, also present in industrial coatings (via two JVs), international operations, and home decor (bath, kitchen). Q2 FY27 saw strong top-line growth (standalone net sales +14.8%, decorative volume +6.4%) but gross margin dipped as price hikes lagged raw material inflation.
out.how_it_makes_money: Primarily decorative paints sold through a wide distribution network, supplemented by industrial/B2B coatings (two JVs: PPGAP auto refinish and general industrial), international operations (~30% Q2 growth), and bath/kitchen decor businesses.

bull.point: Strong volume growth despite steep price hikes
bull.quote: we have been able to grow at a good volume of about 6.4% at the base of the last year, which was almost about an 11% growth

bull.point: VAE backward integration commissioned, expected to cut costs
bull.quote: it should really give us some advantage of 300 bps to 500 bps on relevant products

bull.point: New products now a large share of revenue
bull.quote: the new products contribute to about 18% of the revenues which just shows that the innovation cycle, what we speak is very strong

bear.point: Price hikes not covering inflation; gross margin dipped
bear.quote: we have taken a 7% price increase in quarter one, almost about a 5% price increase in quarter two, but it doesn't match the inflation

bear.point: Anti-dumping duty on TiO2 adds 2-3% cost
bear.quote: it could have an impact from anywhere between 2% to 3% of the overall thing

bear.point: Industrial and international margins lag on price pass-through
bear.quote: In JV2, which is the APPPG, there has been a greater lag of seeing some of those increases

watch.point: Whether Q3 festive/wedding demand delivers 8-9% volume growth
watch.quote: it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward

watch.point: Whether EBITDA margin holds the 18-20% band amid inflation and ADD
watch.quote: for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%
